items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... I’m quite pleased to have saxophonist Carmen Leggio with me today. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Hello, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Tarrytown, New York. I’m quite pleased to have saxophonist Carmen Leggio with me today.
